hybrid_multi_fractal: hybrid_multi_fractal(position, H, lacunarity, octaves, offset, gain, noise_basis=noise.types.STDPERLIN)
Returns hybrid multifractal value from the noise basis at the specified position.
multi_fractal: Returns multifractal noise value from the noise basis at the specified position.
noise: Returns noise value from the noise basis at the position specified.
noise_vector: Returns the noise vector from the noise basis at the specified position.
random: Returns a random number in the range [0, 1].
random_unit_vector: Returns a unit vector with random entries.
ridged_multi_fractal: ridged_multi_fractal(position, H, lacunarity, octaves, offset, gain, noise_basis=noise.types.STDPERLIN)
Returns ridged multifractal value from the noise basis at the specified position.
seed_set: Sets the random seed used for random_unit_vector, random_vector and random.
turbulence: turbulence(position, octaves, hard, noise_basis=noise.types.STDPERLIN, amplitude_scale=0.5, frequency_scale=2.0)
Returns the turbulence value from the noise basis at the specified position.
turbulence_vector: turbulence_vector(position, octaves, hard, noise_basis=noise.types.STDPERLIN, amplitude_scale=0.5, frequency_scale=2.0)
Returns the turbulence vector from the noise basis at the specified position.
variable_lacunarity: Returns variable lacunarity noise value, a distorted variety of noise, from noise type 1 distorted by noise type 2 at the specified position.
voronoi: Returns a list of distances to the four closest features and their locations.
